name: SUNSwap V2
description: Uniswap-V2-style constant-product DEX on TRON run by SUN.io (Factory + Router02 + per-pair contracts, 0.3% fee). An agent can swap TRC-20 tokens and TRX, quote with getAmountsOut, add/remove liquidity and look up pairs on-chain, or get best routes across SunSwap V1/V2/V3/V4, PSM and SunCurve from the official SUN.io routing API.

keyFunctions.description: Quote: amounts along path for an exact input (amountIn in the input token's base units). Includes the 0.3% fee per hop. Use WTRX TNUC9Qb1rRpS5CbWLmNMxXBjyFoydXjWFR in the path for TRX. Apply slippage to the last element to get amountOutMin.
Quote: required input for an exact output along path.

(amountIn, amountOutMin, path, to, deadline). Sell an exact amount of a TRC-20 for another TRC-20. Approve the Router on the input token first. deadline is a Unix timestamp in seconds. Path hops must be existing V2 pairs.

(amountIn, amountOutMin, path, to, deadline). Sell a TRC-20 for native TRX; path must end with WTRX. Approve the Router first.
(amountOut, amountInMax, path, to, deadline). Buy an exact output amount spending at most amountInMax.
Same as swapExactTokensForTokens but for tokens that take a fee on transfer; returns nothing.

(path, poolVersion, versionLen, fees, data=(amountIn, amountOutMin, to, deadline)). Multi-protocol swap across SunSwap V1/V2/V3, PSM and curve pools, typically fed by the routing API output (pool names e.g. 'v1','v2','v3'; versionLen counts tokens per segment, first entry +1; fees all 0 except V3 hops, last entry 0). Use address T9yD14Nj9j7xAB4dbGeiX9h8unkKHxuWwb (zero address) for native TRX and send callValue = amountIn. Approve input TRC-20 to this router.

offchainApis.name: Smart Router calculation service
offchainApis.use: GET ?fromTokenAddr&toTokenAddr&inAmount (base units) returns the top 3 paths (roadForAddr, pool per hop, amount, impact, fee) across SunSwap V1/V2/V3/V4, PSM and SunCurve; feed into Smart Router swapExactInput.

offchainApis.name: SUN.IO API
offchainApis.use: Read-only REST (GET, JSON): token prices and search, pools/pairs, user positions, transactions, protocol stats, Universal Router quotes, SUN token data. 10 QPS without key; optional X-API-KEY header for higher limits.

offchainApis.name: SUN MCP Server
offchainApis.use: Official hosted SUN MCP Server: read-only SunSwap data (prices, quotes, pools/APYs, protocol stats, positions) with no wallet credentials. Swaps/liquidity need the self-hosted (local) deployment.

actions.name: quote
actions.how: Router.getAmountsOut(amountIn, [tokenIn, ..., tokenOut]) with WTRX for TRX; or GET https://open.sun.io/apiv2/quote/swap/routingInV2 for best multi-protocol route

actions.name: swap-token-for-token
actions.how: approve(Router, amountIn) on tokenIn, then Router.swapExactTokensForTokens(amountIn, amountOutMin, path, to, nowSec+600)

actions.name: swap-trx-for-token
actions.how: Router.swapExactETHForTokens(amountOutMin, [WTRX, token], to, deadline) with callValue = TRX amount in sun

actions.name: swap-token-for-trx
actions.how: approve Router, then Router.swapExactTokensForETH(amountIn, amountOutMin, [token, WTRX], to, deadline)

actions.name: add-liquidity
actions.how: approve both tokens to Router; Router.addLiquidity(...) or addLiquidityETH(token, ..., to, deadline) with TRX callValue

actions.name: remove-liquidity
actions.how: Factory.getPair(a,b) -> approve pair LP to Router -> Router.removeLiquidity(...) / removeLiquidityETH(...)

risks: Permissionless pair creation: anyone can list any TRC-20, including scam, copycat or fee-on-transfer/honeypot tokens. Verify token addresses (e.g. against the SUN.io token list) before swapping.

Router and Smart Router addresses have changed: SUN.io marks older mainnet V2 contracts (TXF1xDbVGdxFGbovmmmXvBGu8ZiE3Lq4mR, TMmRKgwC1hx4azzkXoPzujgQThzF48Actq) and older Smart Routers as deprecated. Use only the current addresses from docs.sun.io.
Fee 0.3% per hop: 0.25% to LPs and 0.05% used to buy back and burn SUN.
Uniswap V2 code: Factory feeToSetter can change the protocol fee recipient; Router/Factory/Pairs are not upgradeable proxies (TronGrid shows plain UniswapV2Factory/UniswapV2Router02 contracts).
TRON resource costs: write calls burn energy/bandwidth; set an adequate feeLimit (docs examples use up to 10,000 TRX for Smart Router) or the tx fails and still costs TRX.

Audits: SUN.io states its contracts were audited by SlowMist (https://docs.sun.io/get-started/risks); DefiLlama links https://sunswap.com/docs/audit-report_en.pdf. Standard AMM risks: impermanent loss, slippage, MEV.
notes: VM is TVM (TRON Virtual Machine, EVM-compatible ABI); addresses are base58 T... Every address above is from docs.sun.io and was confirmed via TronGrid getcontract (Router = UniswapV2Router02, Factory = UniswapV2Factory, WTRX, SunToken, SmartExchangeRouter); Router.factory() and Router.WETH() return the listed Factory and WTRX. Testnet (Nile): Factory THomLGMLhAjMecQf9FQjbZ8a1RtwsZLrGE, Router TYMjxCXfqLpMWW1QToP6hbcjpion7EE25p. The often-cited router TKzxdSv2FZKQrEqkKVgp5DcwEXBEKMg2Ax is not on the official contract page and is left out. SUN.io also runs a Universal Router (TQqgNg13s2DjvXhW1ky4v6TsR8wZGvb7Y4, https://docs.sun.io/protocols/universal-router/reference/contract) with Permit2; it is not part of SunSwap V2 and its functions are not documented here. SunSwap V1/V3/V4 are separate protocols. Decimals per SUN CLI docs: TRX/WTRX/USDT 6, SUN/USDD/JST 18. Router function signatures come from the TronGrid ABI and docs.sun.io main-interfaces page. No specific SunSwap V2 exploit was found on official pages.
